title: Do not emit a provider model ID from memory
purpose: Training-cutoff slugs compile, authenticate, and sometimes silently hit a different model.
trigger: Generated code or docs name a foundation-model API ID without an observed_as_of date and a primary URL.
correct: Cite slug + date + primary models page, or call list-models. If unchecked, write STALE-UNKNOWN.
legacy_evidence_note: Repeated project incident: generated harnesses targeting claude-3-haiku / Haiku v3, gpt-4o as flagship, gemini-1.5-pro, grok-2. Each cost a full return-to-test cycle.

provenance.claim: Rule preserved from v0.2; classification metadata added conservatively.
